name: Three Ways
author: Vestra Player SDK examples
punchline: One plugin written three ways: bind(), player.on with set(), plugin.wire
description:
A speed display, an emulator's status line pushed every frame, a list of 20,000 entries and a command that waits for an answer, each written in the three plugin styles of the SDK documentation.
SDK example: View.bind, Player.on, Scope.state, plugin.wire.
